title: Four sourced hits
summary: The voice diary publishes at most four hits, and each hit keeps who said it, when, and the source.
body: HORBM research note R1, 2026-11-18, recommends a hybrid of BM25 and one static int8 vector per card, scanned exactly and fused with reciprocal rank fusion. The published packet is at most four hits. A missing speaker, date, or source stays visible as unknown.

sources.title: Galion Labs, HORBM R1 retrieval core, 2026-11-18
